senses.sense_definition: A tube composed of cartilage and membrane that connects the larynx to the bronchi, carrying air to and from the lungs; the windpipe.

examples.text: The surgeon had to make an emergency incision into the patient's <w>trachea</w> to restore breathing.
Food accidentally entered his <w>trachea</w>, causing him to cough violently.

senses.sense_definition: One of the network of fine, branching tubes that carry air directly to the tissues in the respiratory system of insects.

examples.text: Air enters through tiny openings along the abdomen and travels through each <w>trachea</w>.
Insects do not have lungs, relying instead on a system of <w>tracheae</w> to deliver oxygen.

senses.sense_definition: A tube or vessel element in the xylem of vascular plants that conducts water and minerals.

examples.text: Under the microscope, the plant's <w>trachea</w> was visible as an elongated fluid-conducting element.
Water moves upward from the roots through each xylem <w>trachea</w> to reach the leaves.
